🧩 FrontierAgent, our agent framework, open-sourced alongside it — native command-line TUI, ReAct and Agent Team modes, one command on macOS and Linux, no preinstall, no hard Docker dependency.
Open-source multi-provider AI gateway for Claude Code and other coding agents, with model routing, streaming, tools, reasoning, fallbacks, and local model support
GradientRank is a real-time data processing engine that powers massive datasets with rapid machine learning model training capabilities.
RagMempool implements distributed memory pooling for optimized resource allocation and congestion management in decentralized networks.
GradientOracle is a predictive analytics framework utilizing machine learning processing and online learning, with built-in optimizer and scheduler.
RagRank utilizes real-time data ingestion and high-performance processing to modeling and anomaly detection on a scalable engine platform.
RagPool enables real-time data processing across a distributed system, utilizing auto-scaling capabilities for optimized performance management.
Pentest Harness — Heaven for Hackers. A self-hosted AI agent harness for authorized pentests, bug bounty, security labs, and CTFs. Bring your own AI model API; sessions stay local.
